scope: PermitOperationType distinction (StageShard vs CommitManifest vs DeleteShard vs GarbageCollectShard)

threat_model_evaluations.description: An attacker intercepts a valid mutation permit issued for Node A and replays it against Node B storing shards for the same object.
threat_model_evaluations.mitigation_implemented: QuorumPermitGrant and QuorumMutationPermit include target_node: NodeId under domain tag FSP-PERMIT-GRANT-V2. NodeEpochFencingTracker::verify_and_apply_mutation_permit_v2 verifies that permit.target_node == Some(self.node_id).

threat_model_evaluations.vector: Destructive operation privilege escalation via staging permit
threat_model_evaluations.description: A stale or compromised coordinator presenting a StageShard permit to execute DeleteShard or GarbageCollectShard RPCs.
threat_model_evaluations.mitigation_implemented: Explicit PermitOperationType enum (StageShard, CommitManifest, DeleteShard, GarbageCollectShard) bound into cryptographic grant signatures and validated by storage nodes prior to mutation execution.

threat_model_evaluations.description: A slow RPC initiated in term T arrives at a storage node after term T has been superseded by term T+1.
threat_model_evaluations.mitigation_implemented: Storage nodes durably enforce monotonic epoch high-water marks and commit index records. Stale terms are fenced with RpcError::Fenced; stale commit indices are rejected with RpcError::Unauthorized.
